<function=python>

def snap(f):
    P=None; blk={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and min(rs)<54: P=min(rs)
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and min(rs)<54:
            blk[n['color']]=(min(rs),min(cs))
    return P, blk
# grid coords: row=(r-13)//6, col=(c-18)//6  (block top-left)
def grid(P,blk):
    g={}
    for c,(r,cc) in blk.items(): g[c]=((r-13)//6,(cc-18)//6)
    return (P-12)//6, g
print('before:', snap(current_frame), grid(*snap(current_frame)))
# Hypothesis: goal = stack in col4, blue(top) green(mid) red(bottom), adjacent.
# Move player to row3 (P=30) to grab red at row31, then RIGHT x4 to col4.
res = action(['DOWN','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT'])
print('after:', snap(current_frame), grid(*snap(current_frame)))
print('result:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})

def snap(f):
    P=None; blk={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and min(rs)<54: P=min(rs)
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and min(rs)<54:
            blk[n['color']]=(min(rs),min(cs))
    return P, blk
# grid coords: row=(r-13)//6, col=(c-18)//6  (block top-left)
def grid(P,blk):
    g={}
    for c,(r,cc) in blk.items(): g[c]=((r-13)//6,(cc-18)//6)
    return (P-12)//6, g
